title: Free food distribution for veterans at Laredo VA Clinic Thursday, Nov. 12
excerpt: Free food for veterans and their families at the Laredo VA Clinic on Thursday, Nov. 12, 9–11 a.m. — drive-through, bring a valid Veteran ID.
content:
Veterans and their families can pick up free food at the Laredo VA Outpatient Clinic on Thursday, November 12, from 9:00 to 11:00 a.m., in a drive-through distribution held with the South Texas Food Bank, according to VA Texas Valley Health Care.

The distribution will be at the Laredo VA Clinic, 4602 North Bartlett Avenue, Laredo, Texas 78041. It is free, and supplies are limited — food will be given out until supplies last.

Those coming should bring a valid Veteran ID and stay in their vehicle. VA staff will check the ID, and volunteers will load the food into the trunk, so drivers should leave space in the trunk.

Source: VA Texas Valley Health Care (VA.gov).
